dct_title_s: Map of pueblo lands of San Jose [Calif.] : finally confirmed to Mayor & Common Council of the City of San Jose
dct_description_sm: surveyed under instructions from the U.S. Surveyor General by George H. Thompson, Dep. Surr.
Shows drainage, townships, ranchos, tract numbers, etc.
Appeared in: Hall, Frederic. The history of San Jose and surroundings ... 1871.
